title: Require Agent Plugin Command Channel Source Relationships
forbids: a literal module-loading edge from curated agent-plugin command or command-support source to @oclif/plugin-plugins or one of its subpaths
why: Native Oclif extension lifecycle and curated agent-plugin lifecycle are separate command channels. Curated command source must not acquire the native external-plugin implementation.
remediate: Keep @oclif/plugin-plugins composition on the native rawr plugins channel. Route curated rawr agent plugins commands through their agent-plugin lifecycle owner instead.
message: Curated agent-plugin commands must not load the native Oclif plugin lifecycle package.
